caveats: Rune of Unleashed Fire: Procs are assumed to target the same unit that triggered them. Procs triggered by damage are assumed to proc damage. Procs triggered by healing/aura are assumed to proc heal.
Band of the Swarmcaller: Damage is assumed to not be split amongst targets hit.
Hexing Grips of the Ophidian Oracle: Damage is assumed to not be split amongst targets hit.
